content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI Young Professional-II Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 18 September 2026. Candidates should report at the venue on this date with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate degree in Genetics & Plant Breeding, Biotechnology, or allied disciplines of Life Sciences to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) post?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000 per month for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the ICAR IARI Young Professional-II (YP-II) recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026 going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute, Hazaribagh, Jharkhand, 825405.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), ID proof, and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual position for Young Professional-II (YP-II) at ICAR IARI.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
